entities.name: snow-covered competition ski course
entities.identification: The broad white competition snow surface in the middle and lower part of the image, extending downhill into the distance.

entities.name: blue route markings on the snow surface
entities.identification: The blue linear bands extending along the passage on the ski course surface and the local transverse colored bands.

entities.name: protective facilities along the edge of the course
entities.identification: The red mesh barriers and white barrier panels with red-and-black patterns along the edge of the ski course.

entities.name: snow-covered coniferous forest
entities.identification: Groups of dark-colored trees outside the ski course, with pointed crowns and snow-covered branches.

entities.name: crowd in winter clothing outside the guardrail
entities.identification: The group of background figures in winter clothing on the outer snowy slope at the left and upper left.

entities.name: metal truss platform
entities.identification: The elevated platform behind the guardrail on the right in the opening image, composed of thin gray poles, horizontal bars, and diagonal cross-bracing.

entities.name: blue-covered course equipment
entities.identification: The equipment in front of the tree belt on the right, with a cyan-blue upright covering and a light-colored top component.

entities.name: Object K
entities.identification: The gate consisting of two orange-red thin poles supporting an orange-red fabric panel, with a black rectangular panel in the center of the fabric panel.

entities.name: tips of the red skis
entities.identification: The front ends of the red skis intermittently exposed at the lower edge in the first-person view, with the pair of skis treated as one prop group.

entities.name: gray-blue sky
entities.identification: The low-contrast gray-blue sky background above the tree crowns and slope contours.

entities.name: snow-covered hillside outside the course
entities.identification: The white undulating slope surface outside the protective facilities, mainly in the upper left of the image.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The dark-colored human-shaped outline of a head, shoulders, and upper body on top of the metal truss platform on the right, adjacent to the equipment.

entities.name: dark-colored equipment on the platform
entities.identification: The dark-colored block-like outline of equipment on top of the metal truss platform on the right, near Person B.
